description: Black-dot appearance presets for non-YOLO visual calibration. Values are backend scale parameters unless noted otherwise.

appearance_notes.mask_policy: main black-dot mesh only; local coupling patch is not labeled
appearance_notes.visual_goal: P101040 blue migration baseline; compare against blue real black-dot crops before production
known_risks: P101040 blue is translucent/semi-transparent, so appearance should not be judged with opaque QC71336 thresholds
multi-instance black-dot mode is planned but not enabled in this first migration smoke

qc7_5244_white_current_backend_v1.backend_alias_note: The current black-dot backend uses QC75244_white as the historical compatibility key for the real-data target named QC7-5244 white.

appearance_notes.mask_policy: main black-dot mesh only; local coupling patch is not labeled
appearance_notes.visual_goal: QC7-5244 white migration baseline; compare against QC7-5244 white real black-dot crops before production
known_risks: backend naming uses QC75244_white while real data folder uses QC7-5244白色
QC7-5244 white mixed_color_contamination is handled by its separate reference backend, not by this black-dot preset

appearance_notes.mask_policy: main black-dot mesh only; local coupling patch is not labeled
appearance_notes.visual_goal: small embedded dark dot with subtle local coupling patch
known_risks: visible size must be judged by real crop contact sheets, not bbox alone
white material brightness can make defects appear more visible

qc71336_white_smaller_soft_v1.source: diagnostic candidate for smaller/subtler white-part black dots

appearance_notes.mask_policy: main black-dot mesh only; local coupling patch is not labeled
appearance_notes.visual_goal: test whether current dots are still too large or too dark
known_risks: may become too small for mask/bbox stability
requires count=3 to count=5 visual smoke before use

appearance_notes.mask_policy: main black-dot mesh only; local coupling patch is not labeled
appearance_notes.visual_goal: gray part migration baseline; compare against QC71336 gray real black-dot crops before production
known_risks: gray material is darker than white, so visibility and contrast thresholds must be rechecked
do not reuse white black-dot preset metrics as acceptance evidence
